title: Middle Office - Manager
description:
The Officer will be responsible for executing and overseeing daily accounting and reconciliation activities across investment portfolios, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery. The role requires strong analytical capability, operational rigor, and the ability to manage exceptions, risks, and stakeholder expectations within a middle office environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Reconciliation & Break Management
* Perform daily cash, position, and transaction reconciliations across multiple asset classes
* Investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks within defined SLAs
* Identify root causes and drive permanent resolution of recurring discrepancies
* Liaise with custodians, fund administrators, and internal teams to resolve issues
* Accounting & TMV Oversight
* Support IBOR accounting activities including journal entries, accruals, and valuation checks
* Review trial balances and assist in TMV validation processes
* Ensure adherence to accounting standards and internal control frameworks
* Exception Handling & Risk Control
* Monitor exceptions and escalate high-risk items in a timely manner
* Ensure compliance with operational risk and control procedures
* Participate in audits and provide required documentation and explanations
* Process Improvement & Automation
* Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce manual intervention
* Support automation initiatives and system enhancements
* Contribute to standardization and documentation of processes
* Stakeholder Management
* Act as a point of contact for internal stakeholders, clients, and external partners
* Provide clear and concise reporting on reconciliation status and key issues
* Collaborate with front office, fund accounting, and technology teams
* Team Contribution
* Mentor junior team members and support knowledge sharing
* Assist in workload management and ensure timely deliverables

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field (CA/CFA/CPA is a plus)
* 10 + years of experience in middle office, fund accounting, or reconciliation roles
* Strong understanding of financial instruments (equities, fixed income, derivatives preferred)
* Experience with reconciliation tools and accounting systems

**Key Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Good understanding of financial markets and investment operations
* Effective communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work under tight deadlines in a dynamic environment

**Preferred Competencies**

* Knowledge of reconciliation platforms (e.g., TLM, DUCO, IntelliMatch)
* Exposure to automation tools (e.g., Alteryx, Python, RPA)
* Understanding of regulatory and audit requirements

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: EHS & Maintenance Manager
description:
**Position Title:**
Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) & Maintenance Manager
  
  
*Hydro Prokav Pumps India Pvt Ltd*
*Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu*
**About Us**
*Hydro Prokav Pumps, part of Ingersoll Rand, a leading progressive cavity pump (PCP) manufacturer and exporter headquartered in Coimbatore, India. Hydro Prokav core expertise lies in PCP solutions, the perfect choice for handling tough, viscous, abrasive, and high-consistency mediums. Equipped with state-of-the-art machinery and testing facilities, our integrated plant ensures precision manufacturing and rigorous quality control for every pump produced.*
**Job Summary**
*The EHS & Maintenance Manager is responsible for leading and managing the site's Environment, Health & Safety, Sustainability, Engineering Maintenance, Utilities and Facility Management functions.*
**Responsibilities**
**Maintenance Planning & Execution**

* Full statutory and regulatory compliance
* Prevention of injuries, occupational illnesses and environmental incidents
* Implementation of corporate EHS policies and standards
* Effective ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems
* Reliable and safe operation of plant machinery and utilities
* Preventive and predictive maintenance effectiveness
* Equipment reliability and reduction of unplanned downtime
* Effective energy and resource management
* Engineering and EHS project execution
* Sustainability and emission reduction
* Emergency preparedness
* Continuous improvement in safety, environmental and operational performance

**EHS, Compliance & Safety**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS and statutory requirements, including TNPCB, DISH, Fire & Rescue Services, CEIG, DTCP and other regulatory authorities.
* Manage statutory licenses, consents, approvals, renewals, registers, inspections and regulatory submissions.
* Implement and maintain ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems, including internal/external audits, management reviews and CAPA closure.
* Lead HIRA, JSA, Permit-to-Work, LOTO, contractor safety and high-risk activity controls.
* Drive accident prevention, SIF/Fatality Prevention, safety inspections, near-miss reporting and proactive safety programs.
* Lead incident investigations, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive actions.
* Maintain Emergency Response Plans and conduct periodic mock drills for fire, chemical spills, medical and other emergencies.
* Conduct EHS training, employee engagement and safety awareness programs to strengthen site safety culture.

**Environment & Sustainability**

* Manage environmental compliance covering air emissions, effluent, hazardous waste, chemical management, water, energy and waste disposal.
* Manage applicable EPR compliance, authorized waste vendors and environmental documentation.
* Drive energy efficiency, GHG emission reduction, renewable energy, water conservation, recycling and waste-reduction initiatives.
* Collect, validate and report EHS and sustainability performance data to corporate stakeholders.
* Support Scope 1, Scope 2 and relevant Scope 3 GHG accounting, ESG reporting, LCA and Product Carbon Footprint initiatives, as applicable.
* Develop and monitor environmental and sustainability KPIs against corporate targets.

**Maintenance, Engineering & Utilities**

* Lead overall mechanical, electrical, utility, facility and infrastructure maintenance activities.
* Develop and execute preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance programs to improve equipment reliability and availability.
* Monitor equipment performance through PM compliance, downtime, MTBF, MTTR and repeat breakdown analysis.
* Lead RCA for major equipment failures and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Ensure reliable operation of electrical systems, compressors, HVAC, water systems, fire protection systems and other plant utilities.
* Manage electrical safety and CEIG compliance, including preventive maintenance and statutory inspections.
* Plan shutdown maintenance, critical spare requirements, AMCs and maintenance service contracts.
* Lead engineering, safety, sustainability and energy-efficiency improvement projects.
* Manage contractors and vendors for maintenance and engineering activities with strong EHS controls.
* Prepare and control EHS and maintenance budgets, optimizing cost without compromising safety, compliance or equipment reliability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* BE mechanical/Electrical with 10-15 years experience

**Key Competencies**

* EHS statutory and regulatory compliance
* ISO 14001 & ISO 45001
* HIRA, JSA, PTW & LOTO
* Incident Investigation & Root Cause Analysis
* SIF / Fatality Prevention
* Environmental & Chemical Management
* Sustainability & ESG Reporting
* GHG Accounting & Carbon Reduction
* Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
* Mechanical & Electrical Maintenance
* Equipment Reliability, MTBF & MTTR
* Utilities & Facility Management
* Energy Management
* Engineering Project Management
* Contractor & Vendor Management
* Budget & Cost Management
* Team Leadership & Cross-functional Coordination

**What We Offer**

* We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success.
* Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication.
* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee development with LinkedIn Learning
* Employee recognition via Awardco
* Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.

title: MS - FDL-Manager - AI Architect
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Platform Governance**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Platform Governance to manage the governance processes, controls, and compliance oversight for enterprise platforms supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines platform governance, risk coordination, and team leadership to promote secure, reliable, and well-controlled platform services. The ideal candidate will work with platform engineering, operations, security, architecture, and business teams to embed practical governance across services supporting P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for coordinating governance reviews, maintaining control and exception records, monitoring adherence to approved standards, and supporting audit readiness within the assigned platform scope. You will enable delivery teams to meet governance requirements while escalating unresolved risks to accountable decision-makers.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Platform Governance & Control Oversight**

* Maintain the platform governance framework, control inventory, ownership matrix, and review calendar in alignment with enterprise policies and approved architecture and security standards.
* Translate approved policies into practical control requirements, review checklists, and evidence expectations for platform provisioning, operation, change, and retirement.
* Coordinate governance reviews for new platform services and significant changes, tracking required approvals, control gaps, and actions before release or onboarding.
* Maintain platform and service inventories with accountable owners, criticality classifications, dependencies, and lifecycle status; coordinate periodic validation with service teams.
* Coordinate periodic access reviews with identity and service owners, covering privileged access, least privilege, segregation of duties, and timely removal of inappropriate access.
* Administer policy exceptions and risk registers, documenting rationale, compensating controls, accountable owners, expiry dates, and approvals by designated authorities.

**Risk, Compliance & Audit Readiness**

* Plan risk-based governance and control review activities, prioritizing critical platforms, overdue findings, and material changes in consultation with security and risk teams.
* Coordinate control self-assessments and evidence collection; verify evidence completeness and traceability while supporting independent assurance and audit teams.
* Track and report control coverage, review completion, overdue remediation, expired exceptions, and repeat findings; escalate material issues through agreed governance forums.
* Coordinate remediation plans with control owners, monitor milestones, and obtain supporting evidence before recommending closure to authorized reviewers.
* Partner with security, privacy, legal, and data governance teams to map applicable obligations to platform controls, including logging, retention, data protection, and third-party service requirements.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of governance analysts or coordinators, allocating review, reporting, and evidence-management responsibilities across supported platforms.
* Build a culture of accountability, constructive challenge, consistent documentation, and collaboration with engineering and operational teams.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop backup coverage for recurring governance and audit activities.
* Coach team members on control assessment, evidence quality, risk documentation, issue tracking, and clear stakeholder communication.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance stakeholders and platform owners to understand business criticality, reporting dependencies, and control requirements for supported services.
* Coordinate with architecture, engineering, operations, security, and risk teams to clarify control ownership and resolve governance gaps without duplicating responsibilities.
* Facilitate governance forums, prepare decision papers, record decisions and approvals, and track agreed actions to completion.
* Communicate governance status, emerging risks, exceptions, audit readiness, and remediation progress clearly to management and business stakeholders.

**Governance Enablement & Continuous Improvement**

* Standardize reusable control checklists, evidence templates, onboarding criteria, and exception workflows to improve consistency and reduce administrative effort.
* Work with engineering teams to automate control monitoring and evidence collection where feasible, including policy-as-code checks and governance dashboards.
* Review lessons from incidents, audits, and control failures; recommend framework improvements and track evidence of resilience testing, lifecycle reviews, and secure service retirement.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in technology governance, platform operations, IT risk, compliance, or technology controls, including responsibility for enterprise platform governance activities.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating cross-functional control reviews and developing governance or operations teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and its governance capabilities, including resource organization, policy enforcement, identity, and audit logging.
* Understanding of enterprise platform services, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and service lifecycle management sufficient to assess control coverage and engage technical owners.
* Experience with control inventories, risk and exception registers, evidence repositories, and GRC or IT service management tools.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration management, and policy-as-code concepts to support governance integrated into engineering workflows.
* Understanding of access governance, segregation of duties, data classification, encryption, logging, retention, vulnerability management, and third-party technology risk.

**Governance & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to coordinate risk-based control reviews, audit preparation, issue remediation, and governance reporting across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Familiarity with relevant frameworks such as COBIT, ITIL, ISO/IEC 27001, or NIST; ability to apply requirements proportionately to platform scope and business risk.
* Strong planning, documentation, analytical, and follow-through skills, including the ability to interpret control metrics and distinguish evidence gaps from confirmed control failures.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), reporting dependencies, and internal control requirements is preferred.
* Experience supporting governance for finance transformation, ERP-connected platforms, enterprise analytics, or other business-critical technology services is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain control gaps, risk implications, and required actions to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, challenge constructively, and balance proportionate governance with efficient delivery while respecting approval boundaries.
* High ownership mindset focused on control effectiveness, reliable evidence, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: MS - FDL - Senior Manager - AI Architect
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Manager – AI Architect**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – AI Architect to lead the strategy, architecture, and governance of enterprise AI solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines AI/ML architecture, technical leadership, and people management, translating business needs into secure, scalable, and responsible AI solutions. The ideal candidate will integrate predictive machine learning, generative AI, and appropriately controlled agentic workflows with enterprise applications and data to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will own AI architecture quality and technology roadmaps across engagements, lead architects and technical specialists, and partner with data science, engineering, product, security, risk, and business teams to guide solutions from discovery through production adoption and measurable value realization.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**AI Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Define the AI architecture strategy and roadmap, aligning prioritized use cases with enterprise technology standards, data readiness, risk appetite, and business objectives.
* Lead discovery and feasibility assessments; determine when rules, analytics, traditional ML, or generative AI are appropriate, and validate options through measurable proofs of concept.
* Design end-to-end AI architectures spanning data ingestion, feature or embedding pipelines, model training or adaptation, retrieval, inference, orchestration, APIs, and enterprise integration.
* Evaluate model providers, open-weight models, cloud AI services, and build-versus-buy options; balance quality, latency, scalability, cost, licensing, data residency, and vendor dependency.
* Establish reference architectures and design standards for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model serving, and agentic workflows, including permission-aware retrieval, tool authorization, and human approval for consequential actions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve complex AI design challenges; guide model selection, prompting, fine-tuning where justified, evaluation design, and integration with production systems.

**AI Delivery, Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across AI initiatives, defining acceptance criteria, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and stage gates from experimentation through production readiness.
* Partner with engineering and platform teams to establish MLOps and LLMOps practices, including versioned datasets, models and prompts, reproducible evaluation, deployment controls, and rollback.
* Define task-specific evaluation frameworks covering predictive performance, groundedness, retrieval quality, hallucination risk, robustness, fairness where relevant, latency, and cost; validate against representative test data and business baselines.
* Design production monitoring for data and model drift, output quality, reliability, usage, and inference spend; establish fallback behavior, incident response, and controlled model or provider updates.
* Embed responsible AI, privacy, security, and applicable compliance controls with risk and legal teams, including data provenance, audit trails, prompt-injection defenses, sensitive-data protection, and risk-based human oversight.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale an AI architecture team, coordinating data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, and application specialists across engagements; develop architects and technical leads.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance AI practice focused on rigorous experimentation, responsible innovation, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource planning, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with AI delivery demand and evolving technology needs.
* Mentor architects and technical specialists on AI design, evaluation rigor, production readiness, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen peer reviews and communities of practice.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance transformation leaders, product owners, and clients to identify AI opportunities, clarify process constraints, and define measurable success criteria.
* Present AI solution options, limitations, investment needs, and risk trade-offs to decision-makers; align expectations on automation boundaries, human review, and business value.
* Lead AI architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and demonstrations, including solution narratives, prototypes, estimates, data requirements, and implementation assumptions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, evaluation results, residual risks, adoption readiness, and realized business impact clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable AI Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable AI reference designs, evaluation suites, retrieval components, model integration patterns, and governance templates to accelerate consistent delivery.
* Assess emerging AI capabilities through structured experiments and business cases; scale only where evidence supports performance, operational feasibility, and acceptable risk.
* Enable finance-focused capabilities such as document intelligence, knowledge assistants, forecasting, and anomaly detection, with traceable outputs and controls appropriate to each use case.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across software engineering, data platforms, solution architecture, or AI/ML, including substantial experience architecting and deploying production AI/ML solutions.
* 5+ years of technical people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or engineering teams and delivering complex, cross-functional AI or data initiatives.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including managed AI services, deployment options, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Strong foundations in machine learning, model evaluation, and applied statistics, with practical expertise in generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and model adaptation trade-offs.
* Strong Python and software architecture skills, with experience in ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn), APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise application integration.
* Experience with MLOps and LLMOps, including experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation automation, CI/CD, model serving, observability, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of AI security and responsible AI, including data leakage, prompt injection, model limitations, explainability, fairness assessment, access controls, and human-in-the-loop design.

**AI Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide AI solutions from use-case discovery and feasibility assessment through architecture, evaluation, production deployment, and operational transition.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews, model and vendor evaluations, AI risk assessments, and production-readiness reviews across multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong skills in technical estimation, capacity planning, inference cost modeling, and total cost of ownership analysis, balancing model quality, latency, reliability, and business value.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise data and business processes; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) and associated control requirements is preferred.
* Experience applying AI/ML to finance transformation, ERP-connected workflows, document processing, forecasting, or enterprise analytics is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, practice development, and coaching skills, with the ability to lead architects and influence data science, engineering, and business teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and the ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations, and risks without overstating results.
* Ability to balance AI strategy with pragmatic implementation, challenge assumptions using evidence, and make sound decisions amid rapidly evolving technology.
* High ownership mindset focused on responsible AI adoption, production reliability, solution quality, and measurable business outcomes.

**Education & Experience**

* 5+ years of architecture or engineering people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or technical leads across multiple programs or engagements.

**Technical Expertise**

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Revanza Developers is a real estate development company based in Tamil Nadu, specializing in thoughtfully planned residential communities. The organization focuses on quality construction, transparent processes, and innovative design to deliver homes that meet modern lifestyle needs. Projects are strategically located to offer convenient access, strong infrastructure, and long-term value for residents and investors. With an emphasis on sustainable planning and customer-centric development, Revanza Developers aims to build communities that foster comfort, trust, and growth.

Role Overview

We are looking for a customer-focused CRM Manager to manage the complete post-sales customer journey—from plot booking and payment collection to documentation, registration, and handover. The role requires strong coordination with sales, accounts, legal, and project teams to deliver a smooth customer experience and timely completion of commitments.

Key Responsibilities

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary contact for customers after booking and ensure a smooth handover from the sales team.
* Explain payment schedules, documentation requirements, registration procedures, and project updates clearly.
* Handle customer queries, complaints, and escalations with timely follow-up and closure.
* Build customer relationships that support referrals and repeat purchases.

**Booking and Documentation**

* Verify booking forms, customer KYC, plot details, pricing, discounts, and approved payment terms.
* Coordinate allotment letters, sale agreements, payment receipts, and other customer documents.
* Maintain accurate customer files, plot allocation records, and booking status.
* Process cancellation, refund, transfer, and name-change requests according to company policy and approvals.

**Collections and Account Coordination**

* Track payment schedules, send reminders, and follow up on outstanding amounts.
* Work with accounts to reconcile collections, issue receipts, and resolve payment discrepancies.
* Monitor overdue accounts and escalate payment risks promptly.
* Coordinate home or plot loan documentation with customers and financial institutions.

**Registration and Handover**

* Coordinate with legal teams, customers, banks, and registration support teams to arrange sale deed execution.
* Ensure required documents, payment clearances, and internal approvals are ready before registration.
* Coordinate plot identification, boundary verification, possession documentation, and handover with the project team.
* Track pending commitments and follow through until closure.

**Team Management and Reporting**

* Lead CRM executives, allocate responsibilities, and monitor follow-up quality.
* Maintain accurate records in CRM software and establish clear customer communication processes.
* Prepare reports on bookings, collections, outstanding payments, registrations, cancellations, and complaints.
* Keep customer communications aligned with approved project information and company commitments.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; an MBA is an advantage.
* 5–8 years of experience in real estate CRM or post-sales operations, with experience managing a team.
* Preference for candidates with residential plotted development experience.
* Working knowledge of booking documentation, payment reconciliation, sale agreements, and registration coordination.
* Strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and customer-handling skills.
* Proficiency in CRM software, MS Excel, and MIS reporting.
* Fluency in Tamil and English.
* Willingness to travel to project sites and registration offices as required.

Key Performance Indicators

* Collections against agreed payment schedules.
* Reduction in overdue receivables.
* Accuracy and timely completion of customer documentation.
* Registration and handover completion against schedules.
* Customer query resolution time and satisfaction.
* CRM data accuracy and timely reporting.

title: Assistant Manager, Electrical
description:
Assistant Manager, Electrical Gradiant India Private Limited Coimbatore, India 9/15/26 Engineering
  
  
Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end-to-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, lithium and critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide.
  
  
Discover us at gradiant.com.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Seeking a highly skilled Electrical Engineer to join our team and provide technical leadership across water treatment (WTP), wastewater treatment (WWTP), sewage treatment (STP), effluent treatment (ETP), and desalination projects. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in electrical systems design, compliance, and project execution, ensuring seamless integration with other engineering disciplines.

* Perform the electrical design and engineering activities to deliver projects on time and within budget.
* Provide technical expertise in electrical system requirements for WTP/WWTP/STP/ETP/Desal projects.
* Develop, review, and approve electrical engineering drawings, specifications, and reports.
* Conduct technical reviews, analysis, and compliance assessments against industry standards.
* Mentor junior engineers and support staff, fostering professional growth.

* Participate in project meetings, risk assessments, and client/vendor coordination.
* Provide site support, including visits and FAT (Factory Acceptance Tests) for electrical items.
* Assist in project proposals, cost estimates, and schedules related to electrical scope.
* Stay updated on industry trends, technologies, and best practices to drive innovation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).

* Strong knowledge of electrical systems, schematics, layouts, and power system load modeling.
* Proficiency in equipment sizing, cable sizing, and system calculations.
* Familiarity with relevant codes, standards, and regulations.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across disciplines and with external stakeholders.

title: Operations Manager (Factory & Project Execution)
description:
**Job summary**

This job describes an integrated model covering planning, in-house manufacturing and installation, and its case study specifically describes the project manager controlling installation against the approved floor plan, coordinating readiness, inspecting the completed installation with the client, and obtaining handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Sales-to-Project Handover**
   - Take over confirmed PO, BOQ, quotation, approved drawings, specifications, finishes, and client commitments. Ensure complete and accurate project handover from Sales.
2. **Scope Validation**
   - Cross-check PO, quotation, BOQ, and drawings. Identify and resolve quantity, specification, and scope discrepancies before execution.
3. **Project Kick-Off**
   - Conduct project kick-off meetings with Sales, Design, Engineering, Purchase, Maintenance, Production, QC, Logistics, Accounts and Installation teams. Define responsibilities, timelines, and deliverables.
4. **Project Planning & Scheduling**
   - Prepare the master project schedule based on the committed delivery and handover date. Track project milestones and overall progress.
5. **Site Survey & Verification**
   - Coordinate site measurements and verify site conditions, access, lift, loading, flooring, electrical, and other requirements. Ensure site readiness before execution.
6. **Drawing Coordination & Approval**
   - Coordinate preparation and approval of GFC/AFC drawings. Ensure approved drawings are available before production.
7. **Engineering Release**
   - Coordinate detailed production drawings, BOMs, hardware, and special requirements. Ensure accurate and timely release of production information.
8. **Change & Variation Management**
   - Control all changes and revisions through proper documentation and approvals. Evaluate impact on project cost, timeline, and resources.
9. **Material Readiness**
   - Monitor project-specific and long-lead materials with Purchase and Planning teams. Ensure materials are available as per the project schedule.
10. **Production Planning**
    - Coordinate production priorities based on project requirements and installation sequence. Ensure furniture is manufactured as per approved drawings and timelines.
11. **Production Monitoring**
    - Monitor planned versus actual production progress. Follow up with Production teams and resolve delays or bottlenecks.
12. **Quality Management**
    - Ensure pre-dispatch inspection of dimensions, finishes, hardware, quantity, and functionality. Ensure products meet approved specifications and quality standards.
13. **Client & Stakeholder Coordination**
    - Act as the primary project contact for clients, architects, PMCs, consultants, and contractors. Conduct regular project review meetings and maintain MOMs.
14. **Site Readiness Management**
    - Verify civil, flooring, painting, electrical, access, and other site requirements before dispatch. Confirm site readiness for installation.
15. **Dispatch & Logistics Planning**
    - Plan floor-wise/zone-wise dispatch and delivery schedules. Coordinate packing, labeling, transportation, unloading, and material sequencing.
16. **Installation Planning**
    - Plan installation manpower, supervisors, tools, equipment, and work sequence. Set daily and weekly installation targets.
17. **Site Execution & Monitoring**
    - Monitor daily installation activities and progress against approved drawings and schedules. Ensure installation quality, productivity, and safety requirements are maintained.
18. **Issue Resolution & Escalation**
    - Identify and resolve shortages, damages, drawing mismatches, site obstructions, and other project issues. Track issues with responsible persons and target closure dates.
19. **Snag Management**
    - Conduct joint inspections with the client/PMC and prepare snag lists. Coordinate with concerned teams for timely snag closure.
20. **Project Handover -**
    Coordinate final inspection and completion of all pending works. Prepare handover documentation and obtain client sign-off/handover certificate.
21. **Commercial Closure**
    - Support billing by providing dispatch, installation, handover, and approved variation documents. Coordinate closure of project-related commercial requirements.
22. **Project Closure & Review**
    - Review actual project performance against planned cost, timeline, quality, and resources. Document rework, shortages, delays, lessons learned, and project closure actions.

**Qualification:**

1.   Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Interior Design, Furniture Technology, or related field.

2.   5–7 years of experience in furniture, interior, or fit-out projects.

3.   Good knowledge of furniture manufacturing and installation.

4.   Experience in project planning, production, and site execution.

5.   Ability to read AutoCAD drawings, BOQ, and project specifications.

6.   Good knowledge of MS Excel, MS Office, and ERP software.

7.   Good communication and team coordination skills.

8.   Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

9.   Ability to handle clients, contractors, consultants, and internal teams.

10.  Willingness to travel to project sites as required.

title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Introduction**
The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications And Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge And Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* Exceptional Communication Skills: Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* Strong Interpersonal Skills: Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* Highly Organized: Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* Collaborative Team Player: Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* Proactive and Efficient: Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications**
FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.
  
  
**Additional Notes**

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Admin Officer
description:

From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Administration professional to lead site administration and facility management operations at our Coimbatore facility. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring seamless administrative services, maintaining compliance with Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) standards, managing vendor operations, and supporting overall workplace efficiency while fostering a positive employee experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Administration & Facility Operations**

* Lead and drive all administration and facility management activities at the site while ensuring achievement of functional deliverables and KPIs.
* Support the Site Administration Manager in executing strategic and operational administration initiatives.
* Oversee the day-to-day operations of housekeeping, pantry, mailroom, pest control, horticulture, space management, occupancy planning, and consumable management.
* Monitor workforce attendance, deployment, and resource utilization to ensure operational effectiveness.
* Act as the first point of escalation for administration-related concerns and ensure timely issue resolution.

**Vendor & Contract Management**

* Manage service providers and ensure adherence to agreed SLAs and performance standards.
* Conduct regular reviews with vendors and drive continuous service improvement.
* Ensure availability and compliance of contracts, purchase orders, and related documentation.
* Monitor procurement, inventory, and optimal utilization of departmental materials and consumables.

**EHS, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure strict adherence to all EHS policies and procedures.
* Participate in safety committee meetings, site inspections, and safety walk-throughs.
* Identify risks, generate observations, and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.
* Conduct and periodically review Risk Assessments (RA) for all relevant activities.
* Develop, update, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Method Statements (WMS), and operational templates.
* Lead incident and accident investigations, perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Ensure employees and service providers are trained and compliant with SOPs, WMS, and safety requirements.

**Stakeholder & Employee Engagement**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address operational requirements and improve workplace services.
* Participate in cross-functional meetings, track action items, and ensure timely closure.
* Support guest management, meeting room arrangements, and hospitality requirements at the facility.
* Coordinate with the canteen committee to ensure efficient cafeteria operations, including menu planning and selection of food service equipment and materials.
* Contribute to enhancing employee engagement, workplace experience, and a strong sense of belonging within the organization.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Present site administration performance and operational updates during regional management review meetings.
* Prepare and maintain periodic reports, dashboards, and compliance documentation.
* Drive the implementation of corporate and regional administration directives at the site level.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration abilities.
* Proven expertise in vendor management and service delivery governance.
* Strong guest relations and hospitality management skills.
* Sound knowledge of EHS practices, risk assessments, incident management, and compliance requirements.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and crisis management capabilities.
* Experience in planning, implementing, and managing administration initiatives.
* High level of ownership, reliability, and operational discipline.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other business applications.

**Education & Experience**

* Graduate degree or higher qualification.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in Administration and Facility Management.
* Proven experience supporting large manufacturing or industrial facilities.
* Experience managing administration services for facilities with a workforce of 600+ employees.
* Exposure to vendor management, EHS compliance, and multi-service facility operations is essential.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is an experienced Administration and Facility Management professional with a strong background in industrial or manufacturing environments, capable of driving operational excellence, ensuring regulatory compliance, managing large-scale facility services, and delivering a world-class employee and visitor experience.

title: Infrastructure Operations Manager
description:
**About the Role**

Techjays is an AI engineering and technology consulting firm headquartered in Menlo Park, California, with delivery teams in Coimbatore and Chennai, India.

We are setting up a managed operations team in India to support a US-based B2B SaaS CRM platform. The platform runs on physical servers in a colocation data center rather than on a public cloud such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

The data center provider handles hardware break-fix support, while our team owns day-to-day operations, including infrastructure and platform administration, security and releases, and SQL Server databases.

As
**Manager – Infrastructure and Platform Operations**
, you will be responsible for maintaining the availability, stability, and health of the platform's infrastructure. You will oversee the day-to-day administration of servers, virtualization, storage, networking, and monitoring; manage incidents through root cause analysis and resolution; and serve as the primary operational contact for the client and the data center provider.

You will also lead the operations team supporting this engagement, with the
**Lead – Infrastructure Security and Release Operations**
reporting to you. Your responsibilities will include setting priorities, managing the on-call schedule, reporting on uptime and incidents, and ensuring operational processes and activities are properly documented.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the day-to-day administration of production and non-production infrastructure, including Windows and Linux servers, VMware virtualization, storage, and networking.
* Set up and maintain monitoring, alerting, and dashboards to identify and address issues proactively, before they affect customers.
* Lead incident response for infrastructure and platform issues, conduct post-incident reviews, and track corrective actions through to closure.
* Manage backups and disaster recovery, including regular restore testing and disaster recovery exercises.
* Coordinate with the colocation provider on hardware replacements, remote-hands requests, and planned power and network maintenance.
* Plan capacity for compute, storage, and network resources, and proactively track hardware and software licence renewals.
* Manage the on-call rotation, shift handovers, and weekly status reporting to the client.
* Maintain operational runbooks, architecture diagrams, asset inventories, and configuration records.
* Work closely with the Infrastructure Security and Release Operations Lead and the Database Administrator (DBA) on maintenance windows, upgrades, and cross-team changes.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and implement infrastructure as code where appropriate.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* 15+ years of experience in infrastructure or systems operations, including at least 3 years leading an operations team or managed services engagement.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, and VMware vSphere, along with working knowledge of Linux.
* Experience operating production systems in a colocation or on-premises data center environment.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts, including switching, routing, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and TLS.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Datadog, New Relic, PRTG, Zabbix, SolarWinds, or Prometheus/Grafana.
* Experience managing incidents, problems, and change management processes for production services.
* Willingness to work hours that overlap with US Pacific business hours and participate in an on-call rotation.
* Strong written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to report to and collaborate with US-based client stakeholders.

**Experience**
- 12+ Years

**Location**
- Coimbatore / Hybrid

**Joining**
- Immediate / Within 30 Days

**Work Hours**
-Regular overlap with US Pacific (PST) business hours; on-call rotation

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* ITIL v4 Foundation certification or an equivalent qualification.
* Experience with Ansible, Terraform, or similar infrastructure automation tools.
* Experience hosting .NET applications on IIS.
* Experience supporting multi-tenant SaaS products.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation.
* Paid holidays and flexible paid time off.
* Medical insurance for self and family, with coverage of up to ₹4 lakhs per person.
* Casual dress code and a flexible working environment.
* Direct collaboration with US-based engineering teams on a production SaaS platform.

title: Manager –  Yarn & Fabric Outsourcing
description:
**Department:**
Sourcing / Procurement - Textiles
  
  
**Designation:**
Manager - Yarn and Fabric Outsourcing
  
  
**Experience:**
5-8 Years (preferred)
  
  
**Qualification:**
B.Tech / B.Sc. in Textile Technology or a relevant degree in Textiles
  
  
**Location:**
Perundurai / Coimbatore
  
  
**Industry:**
Textile / Home Textiles / Fabric Manufacturing
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Manager to handle dyed woven fabric and yarn outsourcing activities, ensuring timely material procurement, vendor coordination, quality compliance, and production schedule adherence. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end follow-up with external suppliers, monitoring order status, coordinating with internal departments, and ensuring materials are delivered as per quality, cost, and delivery requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Outsourcing & Vendor Management: Identify, evaluate, and coordinate with external suppliers for dyed woven fabrics and yarn. Maintain strong relationships with vendors, processing units, dyeing units, and textile manufacturers. Follow up on purchase orders, production schedules, material availability, and delivery commitments. Negotiate pricing, lead times, and commercial terms in coordination with the procurement team.
* Dyed Woven Fabric Follow-up

Monitor fabric processing activities, including dyeing, finishing, and quality inspection. Follow up on fabric production status, shade approvals, lab dips, and bulk production approvals. Ensure fabric specifications, colour consistency, shrinkage, and other quality parameters meet requirements. Coordinate with suppliers to resolve fabric quality issues, delays, and reprocessing requirements.
  
  

* Yarn Outsourcing Follow-up

Coordinate with yarn suppliers and spinning mills for timely procurement and delivery. Monitor yarn specifications, counts, blends, quality parameters, and order quantities. Track yarn availability, dispatch schedules, and delivery status. Ensure yarn quality and specifications meet production requirements.
  
  

* Production Planning & Coordination

Coordinate with production, merchandising, purchase, quality, stores, and logistics teams. Track material requirements against production plans and customer delivery schedules. Prepare and maintain outsourcing status reports, pending order reports, and delivery trackers. Proactively identify potential delays and take corrective action to avoid production interruptions.
  
  

* Quality, Cost & Delivery Control

Ensure outsourced materials meet approved quality standards and specifications. Monitor supplier performance in terms of quality, cost, delivery, and responsiveness. Handle supplier complaints, rejections, shortages, and corrective actions. Maintain proper documentation of purchase orders, supplier confirmations, inspection reports, and delivery records.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Strong knowledge of dyed woven fabrics, textile processing, and yarn. Experience in outsourcing follow-up, vendor coordination, and material procurement. Good understanding of fabric dyeing, finishing, shade matching, and yarn specifications.
  
  
Strong follow-up, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and manage time-sensitive deliveries. Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP systems for order tracking and reporting.
  
  
**Preferred Candidate Profile**
Candidates with experience in textile mills, home textiles, woven fabric manufacturing, or textile sourcing are preferred. Practical experience handling external dyeing and processing units, fabric suppliers, and spinning mills.
  
  
Strong ability to manage multiple orders and ensure on-time material availability. Candidates with a proactive approach to vendor follow-up and production coordination will be preferred.
  
  
Further Information, please Contact Mr.Saravanan, Mobile or WhatsApp no +91 638 374 3335 or Send resume at jobs@talentseeds.in

While maintaining responsibility for some quoting activity, this position will be responsible for building a highly responsive and customer driven group. The group will be focused on providing our Flowserve sales organization, customers, distributors, and 3rd party representative channel partners with the most technically sound and competitive quotation solutions for all pertinent inquiries in addition to transferring complete and correct order files for execution to our operations.

* Manage the review of all valve and actuation orders for completeness and correctness and assist in resolving any issues to ensure proper order entry.
* Proper order entry to include clean Order Transfer files that are provided to Order Management in the agreed upon time frame.
* Coordinate and approve commercial terms of purchase orders and/or contracts including SAP generation and approval along with the resolution of any respective terms and conditions issues, based on Flowserve guidelines.
* Implement and oversee a continual training program to insure.
* Team members are properly applying their technical expertise and commercial knowledge during quotation preparation.
* Are updated on our techniques for utilizing any of the respective configurators / sizing and selection tools required for proposal generation.
* Are learning to apply our best practices in sizing, selecting and quoting the best suited Flowserve FPD products.
* Ensure applicable industry standards are applied correctly.

Communication and Stakeholder Management

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate project updates, requirements, risks, issues, and decisions to internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across departments and organizational levels.
* Proven ability to establish and maintain professional relationships with clients, customer management teams, and key decision-makers.

Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to identify project challenges, assess potential business impacts, and develop practical solutions.

Personal Competencies

* Proactive, energetic, and self-motivated approach, with a willingness to learn, adapt to new processes, and accept new challenges.
* Customer-focused and results-oriented mindset, with a commitment to seamless client implementation and onboarding.
* Strong accountability for project deliverables, business requirements, and client expectations.

**Your Daily Tasks**

Client Implementation and Transition

* Manage end-to-end client implementation and onboarding, from contract closure through go-live and transition to Customer Experience.
* Apply the appropriate customer enablement model based on account segment and implementation requirements.
* Lead or facilitate client kickoff meetings for applicable high-value (HV) and high-value enterprise (HVE) accounts.
* Ensure a seamless handover to Customer Experience and Service Delivery teams.

Project Management and Delivery

* Coordinate and prioritize implementation activities, manage project timelines, and maintain comprehensive project plans.
* Ensure timely completion of key implementation milestones and deliverables.
* Update project trackers, implementation plans, and status reports to reflect accurate progress.
* Monitor implementation activities and maintain accountability for project completion.
* Assist with implementation-related projects and strategic initiatives, including site transfers and organic account growth.

Stakeholder and Client Management

* Serve as the primary implementation contact for HV/HVE accounts.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and key decisions to clients, project sponsors, and senior management.
* Collaborate with Growth, Marketing, Recruitment, Finance, Human Resources, IT, Customer Experience, Customer Engagement, and other relevant teams to ensure coordinated implementation.
* Provide coordination and advisory assistance for Micro/Emerging accounts under the Leaner Enablement model, while the Account Executive/Growth Team retains primary responsibility for client communication.

Risk, Compliance, and Governance

* Ensure implementation activities comply with contractual obligations and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, and potential obstacles throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to develop and execute appropriate risk mitigation solutions.
* Monitor implementation progress and escalate issues that require stakeholder intervention or management decisions.

Customer and Team Enablement

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable customer onboarding programs.
* Incorporate ETM onboarding as a standard requirement for new clients.
* Assist clients with offshore team preparation through remote product and process training, onsite immersion, or on-the-job training, as applicable.
* Align onboarding activities, resources, and schedules with client requirements and implementation objectives.

Post-Go-Live Support and Continuous Improvement

* Coordinate the transition from implementation to Customer Experience and Service Delivery to maintain operational continuity.
* Provide post-go-live assistance to ensure successful offshore team establishment and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with Customer Experience, Customer Engagement, and other business functions to identify opportunities for implementation improvements.
* Recommend process enhancements to improve onboarding efficiency, customer enablement, and service delivery outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

* Perform additional duties aligned with the strategic objectives of the Client Solutions organization, as assigned by executive management.

**Join the Top 1% Talent. A Better Career. A Better Life.**

Join us at Emapta, and let your professional journey flourish in the heart of India's vibrant culture!

Recognized as one of Asia's rising tech and outsourcing destinations, we offer a wealth of opportunities to showcase your talent to the world. At Emapta, we connect you with global clients, giving you international exposure without leaving the comfort of your home country. With

title: Engineer - Installation
description:
***Did you know KONE moves over one billion people every day? In 2025, we had annual net sales of EUR 11.2 billion. We employ over 60,000 driven professionals in close to 70 countries worldwide joined together by a shared vision. As a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, it is our mission to improve the flow of urban life.***
***Why this role?***
KONE is embarking upon an exciting growth phase and this represents an opportunity for you to join our
**Coimbatore**
team, as an
**Engineer - Installation.**
***What will you be doing?***
Site supervision:
  
  

* Accountable for safety, quality, and productivity during installation and handovers, and for raising and actioning corrective actions to any detected non-conformities.
* Responsible for the use of correct KONE installation methods and tools by the installation team, and for proper risk assessment for parts of installation where KONE method is not feasible.
* Responsible for proactive site preparations, site readiness, customer deliverables to KONE, site visits and audits, including resolution of non-conformities with customer (supported by Project Manager as needed)
* Responsible for verifying the site execution plan and field cost management as part of the pre-delivery review, assuming site execution responsibility, and thereafter installation activities and handovers.
* Responsible for maintaining realistic MS 3c (material delivery to site) throughout the S-plan, and for confirming of S-plan milestones 3 – 5z.
* Active support to Project Manager and Project Admin for the verification of payment status according to S-plan concept and contract terms
* Responsible for planning and organizing installation activities, site storage and logistics, and needed resources and tools.
* Requests materials to site (MS 3x), confirms arrival of KONE materials to site (MS 3c), receives other materials and services at the site, and performs Goods Receipt.
* Performs handover to installation team (KONE and subcontractors), clarifying the scope of work, completion date and other necessary customer milestone dates, as well as target installation hours for own KONE fitters.
* Organizes continuous huddles with the installation team to empower them and proactively prevent interruptions, ensure smooth, continual flow of work on site, with a focus on efficiency and waste reduction.
* Achieves targets for variation sales and change orders during installation, ensures costs attributable to others are claimed and collected.
* Verifies quality of installation and ensures installation the scope of work is completed. Is accountable for final testing of the equipment and for closing any raised items (tester, customer, third party inspector, as is applicable). Completes a successful handover to maintenance.
* Responsible for quality claims / feedbacks, time sheet approvals, installation documentation, reporting of installation progress, status, cost accumulation, and risks, and managing schedule and other changes.
* Responsible for the management of environmental aspects of the installation (waste and hazardous material handling).

Customer Relationship management:
  
  

* Acts as the primary contact for the customer regarding site management, proactively communicating and using related tools.
* Ensures customer satisfaction with proactive and timely communication, professional installation process, as well as safety and quality of installation.

People leadership and subcontractor relations:
  
  

* Responsible for verifying that installers, testers and other contractors on site are trained, certified, competent, and capable of performing each installation task.
* Accountable for site operatives’ safety, motivation and wellbeing.
* Responsible for identifying Installation operative training needs and communicating these to respective line managers, HR, installation subcontracting companies and procurement.
* Responsible for managing and developing the performance of the team and individuals.
* Responsible for developing and maintaining a proactive and professional relationship with subcontractors’ installation team and ensures they meet their commitments.

Continual improvement:
  
  

* Responsible to follow and continually improve standard ways of working according to LEAN principles.
* Motivates and empowers the installation team to identify waste and make improvements, with a focus on teamwork and collaboration.
* Supports and coaches the installation team to improve their standard ways of working.
* Continually identifies and shares opportunities, root causes and improvement ideas with the team and other collaborators, applying lean tools (Go & See, retrospectives, improvement sessions).
* Promotes success stories of team improvements, recognizing and rewarding efforts to drive continuous improvement.

***What do we offer?***

* Career progression opportunities within a global organization.
* Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work.
* Comprehensive learning and development programs covering a wide range of professional skills.

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*
Read more on
*https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html*

Our team brings a wealth of expertise in education. Our CBSE and Cambridge programmes and teaching methodology are proven and time tested. We have built on vast experience and developed a programme that encompasses modern tools while adhering to traditional principles.
