title: GENERAL MANAGER – AURAWILL BUSINESS
description:
We're Hiring: General Manager – Aurawill

📍 Location: Coimbatore

🏢 Full-time | On-site

Aurawill is one of India's fastest-growing nutrition brands, making traditional, science-backed nutrition simple and accessible for modern families.

In just over a year, we've earned the trust of 1,00,000+ customers and are expanding rapidly across D2C, marketplaces, quick-commerce and retail.

Aurawill is looking for a strong commercial General Manager to own the Brand’s business end-to-end and take responsibility for scaling the brand profitably. This role is for someone who is ready to own the full business rather than a single functional vertical.

**The Opportunity**

Aurawill is a natural health foods brand with an ambition to build a differentiated, trusted and scalable consumer business. The General Manager will be responsible for translating the brand ambition into business growth i.e owning the P&L, shaping strategy, setting priorities and leading the teams and functions required to deliver the plan.

**What You Will Own**

**· P&L and Business Strategy:**
Own the overall Aurawill P&L and business plan; set revenue, gross margin, contribution, profitability and growth priorities; identify the biggest business levers and allocate resources and budgets accordingly.

**· Sales channels:**
Own the D2C channel and other online/offline channels of business end-to-end including acquisition, retention, and channel profitability. Build a scalable growth engine rather than optimising only for topline.

**· Marketing & Brand:**
Partner closely with the marketing team to translate the brand strategy into consumer growth. Own the commercial outcomes of marketing investments while protecting long-term brand equity, positioning and consumer relevance.

**· Supply Chain & Operations:**
Own the operating rhythm from demand planning and procurement through production, inventory, fulfilment, quality and customer experience.

**· Finance & Business Management:**
Work closely with finance to build budgets, forecasts, monthly business reviews, scenario building and investment cases.

**· People & Organisation:**
Lead and align cross-functional teams across sales, marketing, supply chain, finance, operations and other business-critical functions. Build a high-accountability culture with clear goals, ownership and operating cadence.

**· Growth & Innovation:**
Identify new consumer needs, occasions, products, channels and partnerships that can materially expand the business.

**What We Are Looking For**

· Owned a D2C business, category, brand, business unit with full P&L responsibility.

· Strong general-management orientation: able to lead revenue, margins, operations and people rather than operating only within one function.

· Demonstrated ownership of business numbers and comfort being accountable for revenue, gross margin, contribution and profitability.

· Strong understanding of D2C growth & metrics - acquisition, conversion, retention, repeat, CAC, blended CAC, LTV, AOV & Channel mix.

· Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders across marketing, sales, supply chain, finance and operations.

· Strong commercial judgement: able to distinguish between growth that creates value and growth that merely creates topline.

· Comfort working in an entrepreneurial environment with hands on experience where resources and budgets are tight

· Data-fluent and financially rigorous, while retaining strong instinct for consumer and market.

· High ownership, speed of decision-making and willingness to execute when needed.

· A Tamil Speaking professional, preferably who lives in Tamil Nadu

**Ideal Background:**

We are interested in candidates who may currently be working as a D2C / E-commerce lead, Category Head, Growth Head, India Market lead or an equivalent role in a consumer business.

Minimum 5-6 years of relevant experience from D2C-first consumer brands, FMCG, food & beverage, health & wellness, beauty & personal care, nutrition, consumer tech or other categories where the candidate has had genuine commercial ownership and proven cross-functional leadership for a few years.

Entreprenuers who have built and scaled consumer businesses in the past are also welcome to apply.

*Preferred but not mandatory:*
From Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school in India

**What you will get from us:**

· Complete ownership and responsibility of business coupled with people leadership responsibility for a new-age brand that wants to build strong equity in the foods and nutrition business

· Freedom to experiment and decision-making autonomy

· A company with humble-people with good intention and make good quality products that serve consumer health

**The right candidate:**

This role is for someone who wants to build a business, not simply manage a function; be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and be willing to take ownership when something is not working.

* Must be able to hold the energy & range to discuss brand positioning in the morning, review a P&L in the afternoon, challenge inventory assumptions, diagnose a D2C funnel and align a cross-functional team around the next growth priority. The ability to zoom in and out is central to this role.

title: City Head
description:
**City PnL Head – Coliving**

**Zolo | Coliving Business**

Own the city. Drive occupancy. Build systems. Deliver predictable growth.

**Why this role exists**

In coliving, a city is not just a geography.

It is a full business unit with its own demand, occupancy, cost structure, customer experience, and operational complexity.

At city level:

* Demand fluctuates continuously
* Supply is fragmented across multiple properties
* Resident expectations evolve constantly
* Execution gaps immediately affect occupancy and retention

Without strong city-level ownership, operations quickly become reactive.

The biggest failures usually happen when:

* Occupancy is managed week-to-week instead of structurally
* Sales and operations work independently instead of as one system
* Cost leakages go unnoticed
* Accountability weakens across teams
* Escalations consume operational bandwidth daily

As scale increases, the city must operate with:

* Predictability
* Commercial discipline
* Structured execution
* Strong leadership ownership

This role exists to ensure:

* The city runs like a disciplined business unit
* Occupancy remains stable across cycles
* Demand generation stays strong and diversified
* Resident experience remains consistent across properties
* Costs are controlled structurally, not reactively
* Teams operate with ownership and accountability
* Escalations reduce through system-led fixes

If this role is strong:

* Occupancy becomes predictable
* Margins improve consistently
* Teams operate independently and efficiently
* Retention strengthens
* Growth becomes scalable

If this role is weak:

* Occupancy volatility increases
* Conversion weakens
* Costs rise without control
* Escalations dominate operations
* Customer experience becomes inconsistent

This role directly controls:
**Revenue + occupancy + retention + profitability + team performance**

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own city-level revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* Build strong demand generation engines
* Ensure consistent resident experience across properties
* Drive renewals and improve retention
* Control operational costs and eliminate leakages
* Build high-performing sales and operations teams
* Reduce escalations structurally through systems

**This is not a coordination role. This is a full city P&L ownership role.**

**About Coliving – Zolo**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Coliving works only when:

* Demand remains strong
* Occupancy stays high
* Resident experience remains consistent
* Operations are disciplined
* Costs stay under control

At scale:
**City becomes the core operating unit of the business.**

This role directly impacts:
**Revenue + occupancy + retention + operational efficiency + profitability**

**What you will be responsible for**

**1. Own City Business Performance (P&L Ownership)**

* Own city-level revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* Track daily occupancy, booking trends, and pipeline visibility
* Drive predictable performance across properties
* Improve operational and commercial efficiency continuously
* Think in business outcomes, not activities

**2. Build Demand Generation & Sales Performance**

* Build strong local demand channels:
* Colleges
* Corporates
* Brokers
* Local partnerships
* Improve lead-to-booking conversion across the funnel
* Track funnel performance actively:
* Leads
* Visits
* Bookings
* Reduce funnel leakage systematically
* Ensure strong alignment between sales and occupancy goals

**3. Drive Operations & Resident Experience Excellence**

* Ensure SOP adherence across all properties
* Maintain consistent resident experience standards
* Track complaint patterns and escalation trends
* Drive audits and operational improvements proactively
* Ensure operational discipline across teams

**4. Improve Occupancy & Retention**

* Maintain stable occupancy across seasonal cycles
* Drive renewals and reduce churn proactively
* Identify early retention risk signals
* Improve resident continuity and relationship quality
* Ensure smooth admission and move-in experience

**5. Ensure Cost Control & Commercial Discipline**

* Track property-level cost vs budget consistently
* Identify operational leakages proactively
* Ensure vendor discipline and commercial accountability
* Balance resident experience with cost efficiency
* Drive profitability without compromising core standards

**6. Build Strong Teams & Leadership Depth**

* Lead city-level sales and operations teams
* Set targets and review performance regularly
* Build second-line leadership capability
* Act decisively on underperformance
* Create a strong ownership and accountability culture

**7. Handle Escalations & Operational Risks**

* Handle critical resident, parent, or safety escalations calmly
* Ensure structured issue resolution and follow-through
* Reduce repeat escalations through root-cause fixes
* Protect resident trust and brand reputation
* Maintain operational stability during pressure situations

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Occupancy becomes stable and predictable
* Conversion improves consistently across the funnel
* Renewal and retention rates strengthen
* Cost variance remains within planned thresholds
* Complaint repeat rates reduce significantly
* Teams operate with stronger ownership and accountability
* City operations become system-led instead of escalation-led

The city begins to operate like:
**A disciplined and scalable business unit**

Performance becomes:
**Structured + Predictable + Scalable**

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You think in business outcomes instead of tasks
* You can manage multiple operational levers simultaneously
* You balance execution speed with structure
* You are data-driven and action-oriented
* You are comfortable handling ownership and pressure
* You focus on building systems instead of temporary fixes

**Experience we value**

5–8+ years in:

* Operations
* Sales
* Business management roles
* Experience managing:
* Multi-property operations
* Multi-unit business environments
* City-level execution
* Exposure to:
* P&L ownership
* Demand generation
* Operations management
* Cost control

Industry matters less.
**Business ownership maturity matters more.**

**The impact you will have**

* Direct impact on city revenue and profitability
* Build scalable demand and operations systems
* Improve occupancy and retention structurally
* Develop strong leadership pipelines
* Drive long-term city-level business growth

**Why join now**

Coliving is entering its scale phase.

The businesses that win will be defined by:
**City-level execution excellence.**

This role offers:

* Full city business ownership
* High visibility and strategic impact
* Fast growth into regional leadership roles

title: Branch Manager
description:
**Company Description**
The Eye Foundation is a leading eye specialty hospital network in South India with nearly three decades of experience in delivering advanced eye care. The organization has treated millions of patients through its multi-specialty hospitals located in Coimbatore, Bangalore, Tirupur, Nilgiris, and surrounding regions. Known for its commitment to innovation, The Eye Foundation has pioneered several firsts in the field of ophthalmology in India. The institution was among the earliest to introduce laser refractive surgery and laser cataract surgery, significantly enhancing the precision and outcomes of cataract procedures. Team members join a mission-driven environment focused on clinical excellence, patient-centered care, and technological advancement.
  
**Role Description**
The Branch Manager is a full-time, on-site role based at The Eye Foundation’s Coimbatore branch. This position is responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations, including staff coordination, patient service standards, and efficient workflow across clinical and administrative functions. The Branch Manager monitors performance metrics, manages scheduling, and ensures compliance with organizational policies and healthcare regulations. The role includes overseeing financial and resource management at the branch, supporting local marketing initiatives, and building positive relationships with patients, partners, and the broader community. The Branch Manager collaborates closely with medical and administrative leadership to maintain high-quality care and a safe, well-organized facility.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong leadership and team management skills, with experience supervising multidisciplinary staff in a healthcare or service-oriented environment.
* Operational management skills, including clinic or hospital administration.
* Financial and resource management skills, such as budgeting, cost control, and effective utilization of equipment and facilities.
* Customer service and communication skills, with the ability to address patient concerns, support staff, and collaborate with clinical leaders.
* Organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and respond to day-to-day operational challenges.
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, hospital administration, healthcare management, or a related field; a master’s degree or relevant certification is an advantage.
* Previous experience in hospital, clinic, or branch management, preferably within eye care or a similar specialty healthcare setting.
* Comfort working on-site in Thrissur, Kottayam and Kochi in Kerala, with flexibility to adapt to a fast-paced clinical environment and evolving operational needs.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Production Supervisor
description:
**Job Summary**
 Responsible for supervising and managing day\-to\-day production activities involving MIG/TIG welding, riveting, gluing, and torque tightening processes. Ensure production targets, quality standards, safety requirements, and delivery schedules are achieved through effective manpower management, process monitoring, and coordination with Quality, PPC, Maintenance, and other departments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supervise daily production activities related to MIG \& TIG welding, riveting, gluing and torque tightening processes.
* Plan manpower and allocate operators/workers according to production requirements.
* Ensure production targets are achieved as per daily/monthly production plans.
* Monitor welding parameters such as current, voltage, wire feed speed, gas flow and welding sequence.
* Ensure proper execution of MIG/TIG welding, including weld quality, appearance and dimensional requirements.
* Supervise riveting operations and ensure correct rivet type, size, positioning and fastening quality.
* Monitor gluing/adhesive application, including surface preparation, adhesive quantity, curing time and bonding quality.
* Ensure torque tightening is carried out according to specified torque values using calibrated torque tools.
* Verify first\-piece and in\-process quality and coordinate with the Quality Department for inspection and corrective actions.
* Identify welding defects such as porosity, undercut, lack of fusion, cracks, spatter and improper weld profile and take corrective action.
* Ensure proper use and maintenance of jigs, fixtures, welding machines, riveting tools, adhesive equipment and torque tools.
* Monitor machine/tool breakdowns and coordinate with Maintenance for quick resolution.
* Ensure operators follow SOP, Work Instructions, Control Plans and process parameters.
* Maintain production records, rejection/rework records, downtime reports and shift production reports.
* Control material wastage and improve productivity through 5S, Kaizen and continuous improvement activities.
* Train and evaluate operators on welding, riveting, gluing and torque\-tightening processes.
* Ensure proper PPE and safety practices are followed in the production area.
* Coordinate with PPC, Quality, Maintenance, Stores and Engineering departments for smooth production flow.
* Investigate production and quality issues and implement root\-cause and corrective actions.
* Ensure proper shift handover and communicate pending issues to the next shift.
* Maintain discipline, attendance and work allocation within the production team.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Diploma / ITI / BE in Mechanical, Production or related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in sheet\-metal fabrication/manufacturing production
* Strong practical knowledge of MIG \& TIG welding
* Experience in riveting, adhesive/gluing and torque tightening processes.
* Knowledge of welding defects and basic welding quality requirements.
* Ability to read engineering drawings, weld symbols and work instructions.
* Knowledge of measuring instruments and basic inspection methods.
* Experience in manpower handling and achieving production targets.
* Knowledge of 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing and safety practices.
* Good communication, problem\-solving and team\-management skills.


**Immediate Joiners Prefered**

title: Independent Director
description:
**The mandate through a project’s life** 




  





 The company designs and manufactures process equipment used in food\-production environments. The Board needs an Independent Director who can govern the entire obligation created when an engineered system is sold—from interpretation of process requirements through fabrication, site integration, performance acceptance and long\-term service. Success cannot be measured only by dispatch: an apparently complete project can still carry unresolved hygiene, performance, documentation or margin exposure.
 



  





**Gate one: accepting the problem** 




  





 Before a bid becomes a contract, management must understand the customer’s product, process conditions, cleaning method, utilities, interfaces, throughput assumptions and acceptance criteria. The Director will challenge bid governance where requirements are incomplete, guarantees are broad or the proposed solution relies on untested assumptions. Commercial urgency should not bypass engineering review, capacity confirmation, site\-risk assessment or a clear allocation of interface responsibility.
 



  





 The Board should receive visibility into contractual exposure for delay, performance shortfall, contamination, consequential loss, intellectual property and changes in customer scope. Risk premiums and contingencies must be grounded in the actual project rather than applied mechanically.
 



  





**Gate two: freezing a cleanable design** 




  





 The appointee will seek assurance that hygienic design principles are built into equipment geometry, material choice, seals, welds, drainage, accessibility, instrumentation and cleaning validation. Design review should involve manufacturing, quality, service and commissioning, not remain isolated within engineering.
 



  





 Changes after design freeze need controlled technical and commercial assessment.
 



  





 Where digital controls or remote connections form part of the system, the Board must understand software ownership, access privileges, patching, data use and safe fallback. A cyber event that changes a process parameter can become a product\-safety event.
 



  





**Gate three: fabricating what was approved** 




  





 Material identity, surface condition, welding practice, outsourced treatment, calibration and inspection evidence all influence fitness for use. The Director will review how the company qualifies special processes, controls non\-conformance and preserves traceability. Schedule pressure must not move unfinished or conditionally accepted work downstream without named accountability and an agreed closure path.
 



  





 Management information should connect shop loading, material availability, engineering releases, rework and subcontractor performance. Reported project progress should represent earned completion, not expenditure or physical presence on the shop floor.
 



  





**Gate four: integrating at site** 




  





 Installation and commissioning often expose assumptions that were invisible during design. The Director will question site\-readiness checks, change control, safety planning, customer dependencies and escalation routes. Acceptance tests should be objective, witnessed and tied to the contracted duty. Punch lists must distinguish cosmetic completion from issues that prevent safe or hygienic operation.
 



  





 Revenue recognition, retention, warranty provision and project closure should reflect substantive acceptance and remaining obligations. The finance view and the project view must reconcile.
 



  





**Gate five: learning through service** 




  





 Warranty calls, spares demand, cleaning difficulties and repeat interventions contain product\-development intelligence. The appointee will encourage a closed loop from service into design standards, supplier decisions and commercial qualification. Aftermarket strategy should create genuine availability and performance value, not dependency through inaccessible information or restrictive practices.
 



  





**The enterprise decisions surrounding the gates** 




  





 The Director will participate in capacity, technology and market choices. They will evaluate whether modularisation, standard platforms, automation or strategic sourcing can improve delivery without concealing customer\-specific engineering. Working\-capital oversight will cover advances, milestone billing, long\-lead purchases, work in progress, claims and retentions. The Board will expect candid scenario analysis before expanding facilities or entering unfamiliar applications.
 



  





 Leadership review will include engineering authority, project\-management capability, quality independence, service responsiveness and succession for scarce technical roles. Safety, environmental performance and contractor governance will be treated as operating fundamentals.
 



  





**Experience and temperament** 




  





 The ideal candidate has senior responsibility in process equipment, food manufacturing, capital projects, industrial engineering, quality, operations, finance or project\-based business. Experience governing hygienic design, complex commissioning, contract risk or lifecycle service will be useful. The Board needs a person who can explore a technical issue deeply while preserving the distinction between oversight and execution.
 



  





 Candidates must be financially literate, conflict\-free and actively registered in the IICA Independent Directors Databank. Any relationship with customers, engineering consultants, component suppliers, contractors or competing equipment businesses must be declared.
 



  





**Candidate response**

title: Operations Manager, QC, 3P, QC, 3P
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
   

  

 Amazon Operations
   

  

 Amazon Worldwide Operations is the underlying fulfillment and customer service engine that ensures Amazon creates the same consistent, world\-class customer experience every time. We are looking for a high\-potential, agile Operations Manager — someone who thrives on innovation and isn't afraid to challenge the status quo. Join our India Operations team and spearhead the next wave of Hybrid Quick Commerce expansion.
   

  

 Are you ready to lead high\-visibility, strategic projects that directly drive revenue — while harnessing Lean methodologies to transform and optimize operational processes? Join the Hybrid Operations team as an Operations Manager for the 3P Quick Commerce Business. You will oversee 3P stores across the Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu network — driving network expansion, managing operations and performance, guiding store design, and ensuring compliance at every touchpoint. Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, you'll look beyond daily operations to envision scalable, long\-term solutions and challenge the status quo to drive bold growth across the network. A key workstream will be Launches — you will be expected to maintain a high bar on driving launches of stores (Dark Store \& Supermarket format) for the region, ensuring seamless execution and operational readiness from day one.
   

  

 You must be able to dive deep, scrutinize details, and foresee data implications. With deep customer obsession and a strong sense of ownership, you'll identify patterns, spot disruptions early, and drive closed\-loop problem resolution in coordination with cross\-functional teams. You'll raise the bar with every hire and actively mentor your team to build future leaders who can independently own and scale operations.
   

  

 Flexibility to work weekends and travel to stores for launches, setup, and monitoring of 3P operations is essential.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Partner with 3P seller, Category, Supply Chain, Last Mile Ops, Finance, and LM partners to align operational priorities.
* Build and communicate staffing plans, forecasts, and productivity targets to regional stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Last Mile Program team to optimize operational costs through resource effective HC planning.

* Escalate unresolved issues and callouts to WBRs; own corrective actions and drive closure.
* Lead all ARTs — ensuring end\-to\-end stitching of forecast planning, S\&OP, capacity planning for UTR \& OTR, contingency handling, daily peak calls, and accurate reporting.
* Drive operational performance across multiple cities ensuring targets for quality, productivity, safety, and customer experience are consistently met. The candidate will be responsible for both UTR (Under the roof) and OOR (Out on road) metrics.
* Identify and lead process improvement, operational simplification, and automation initiatives.
* National Level Projects: Lead or contribute to national\-level projects on quality improvement, operational excellence, and cost optimization
* Drive a strong safety culture through audits and zero\-incident targets; ensure compliance with food safety, FSSAI, and local regulatory requirements.
* Ensure timely launch for Quick Commerce (QC) Hybrid stores across T10\+ network and escalate to Launch team for any lag/delay/breach in the launch workstream; own resolution timelines and corrective actions.


**Additional Responsibilities**
 Monitor and manage operational performance of existing Fresh 3P stores across T10\+ cities.

 2\+ years of employee and performance management experience.
   

  

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
   

  

 We have a 5\-day work week but given the 7 days a week operation, the 2 scheduled days off will vary based on shift patterns and business needs.

* 3\+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

title: Fabrication & Production supervisor
description:
Company Overview:
   

  

 If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Production Supervisor leads day\-to\-day operations within the fabrication shop and final packaging area, ensuring safe, efficient, high\-quality production that meets customer delivery commitments. This role is responsible for supervising shop\-floor personnel, coordinating production activities across work centers, managing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement through Lean and operational\-excellence practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supervise fabrication shop and final packaging operations to achieve production, quality, safety, and on\-time delivery targets.
* Plan, prioritize, and schedule production activities across multiple work centers based on workload, capacity, material availability, and delivery commitments.
* Assign daily work to shop employees according to skill level, certifications, workload, and production priorities.
* Maintain and regularly update the shop\-floor skill matrix; identify training needs and coordinate employee development activities.
* Ensure compliance with Flowserve safety policies, safe work practices, and applicable environmental requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by conducting regular safety discussions, identifying risks, and ensuring corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensure production processes comply with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 requirements, including adherence to documentation, traceability, inspection, and record\-retention procedures.
* Monitor and manage key operational KPIs, including utilization, efficiency, productivity, scrap, rework, quality performance, and schedule adherence.
* Analyze production losses, quality issues, and daily shop\-floor constraints; implement corrective and preventive actions using structured problem\-solving tools.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and Operational Excellence initiatives, including AMEF/FMEA, Value Stream Mapping, 5S/6S, SMED, standard work, visual management, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Apply statistical process\-control principles to monitor process performance, identify variation, and improve product quality.
* Support inventory management activities, including material availability, WIP control, inventory accuracy, and coordination with planning and supply chain teams.
* Ensure appropriate use of ERP systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, and other production\-planning tools for reporting, scheduling, and daily operational management.
* Review and interpret technical drawings, work instructions, manufacturing procedures, inspection plans, and customer specifications.
* Ensure fabrication and assembly activities comply with applicable engineering and industry standards, including API 610, ASME, AWS, and other relevant requirements.
* Support and oversee API and non\-API pump manufacturing processes, ensuring that approved procedures and quality requirements are consistently followed.
* Conduct training for shop employees on safety, quality, procedures, technical requirements, Lean practices, and standard work.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, and Maintenance teams to resolve operational issues and improve overall plant performance.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–7 years of relevant manufacturing experience, including experience supervising shop\-floor operations.
* Demonstrated experience in fabrication shop operations and final packaging activities.
* Working knowledge of CNC programming and machining/manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous\-improvement tools, including AMEF/FMEA, VSM, 5S/6S, SMED, and root\-cause analysis.
* Experience with production planning, capacity management, work\-center scheduling, and inventory/WIP management.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, process control, and ISO 9001/ISO 14001 requirements.
* Familiarity with API 610, ASME standards, and preferably AWS welding standards.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, work instructions, and manufacturing procedures.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, ERP systems, and Microsoft Project or comparable scheduling software.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and team\-development skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in pump manufacturing, including API and non\-API pump production processes.
* Experience implementing Lean, Operational Excellence, or continuous\-improvement initiatives in a manufacturing environment.
* Exposure to statistical process control, quality tools, and structured corrective\-action methodologies.
* Knowledge of welding, fabrication, assembly, testing, and packaging processes for industrial equipment.

**What We Are Looking For**
* 5– 8 years of experience in IT operations, service management, or incident management roles, with significant exposure to major incident handling.
* Deep understanding of ITIL processes, especially incident, problem, change, and service continuity management.
* Proven experience managing high\-impact, enterprise\-wide incidents in complex, multi\-cloud or hybrid IT environments.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and crisis coordination skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities under high\-pressure situations.
* Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to drive cross\-functional teams during critical incidents.

* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid infrastructure.
* ITIL Intermediate or Expert certification.
* Knowledge of automation, orchestration, and incident management dashboards.
* Experience in stakeholder reporting to C\-level executives.
* Exposure to compliance, audit, and regulatory requirements for IT operations.

description:

description:
WE ARE HIRINGAdmissions Sales \& Operations Manager
 



 🏢 Company: Dream Life Educational Services
 



 📍 Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
 



 💼 Work Mode: Full\-Time \| Work From Office
 



 👥 Reporting To: CEO \& Management
 



 🎓 Industry: Education \| College Admissions \| EdTech
 



  





 Compensation
 


* Fixed CTC: ₹3\.5–₹4\.2 LPA
* Performance\-Linked Incentives: Up to ₹3 LPA
* Total Earning Potential: ₹7\+ LPA
* Final compensation will depend on relevant experience, team\-handling capability, previous performance and interview assessment.



 About Dream Life Educational Services
 



 Dream Life Educational Services is a Coimbatore\-based education consultancy supporting students and parents with college selection, career counselling and admissions across Tamil Nadu and Bengaluru.
 



 As part of our 2027 expansion, we are looking for an experienced and performance\-driven Admissions Sales \& Operations Manager to lead our admissions, telecalling, counselling and office operations.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 The Admissions Sales \& Operations Manager will be responsible for managing the company’s day\-to\-day admissions sales and operational activities.
 



 The selected candidate will work directly with the CEO and management and take ownership of the telecalling team, closing counsellors, CRM processes, lead management, recruitment support, training, performance monitoring and admission\-target achievement.
 



 This is a leadership position suitable for a candidate who can independently manage teams, establish processes and drive business growth.
 



  





 Key ResponsibilitiesSales and Admissions Management
 


* Manage the complete student\-admission process, from lead allocation to admission confirmation.
* Set daily, weekly and monthly targets for telecallers and closing counsellors.
* Monitor lead\-response time, follow\-ups, counselling quality and conversion rates.
* Support the team in handling difficult parent objections and high\-value admission closures.
* Ensure hot leads are transferred to closing counsellors without delay.
* Track admission documentation, fee payments and confirmation status.
* Develop and execute strategies to achieve monthly and annual admission targets.



 Team Management
 


* Manage telecallers, admission counsellors and other sales\-support employees.
* Conduct daily morning meetings and evening performance reviews.

title: Admissions Sales & Operations Manager
description:
WE ARE HIRINGAdmissions Sales \& Operations Manager
 



 🏢 Company: Dream Life Educational Services
 



 📍 Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
 



 💼 Work Mode: Full\-Time \| Work From Office
 



 👥 Reporting To: CEO \& Management
 



 🎓 Industry: Education \| College Admissions \| EdTech
 



  





 Compensation
 


* Fixed CTC: ₹3\.5–₹4\.2 LPA
* Performance\-Linked Incentives: Up to ₹3 LPA
* Total Earning Potential: ₹7\+ LPA
* Final compensation will depend on relevant experience, team\-handling capability, previous performance and interview assessment.



 About Dream Life Educational Services
 



 Dream Life Educational Services is a Coimbatore\-based education consultancy supporting students and parents with college selection, career counselling and admissions across Tamil Nadu and Bengaluru.
 



 As part of our 2027 expansion, we are looking for an experienced and performance\-driven Admissions Sales \& Operations Manager to lead our admissions, telecalling, counselling and office operations.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 The Admissions Sales \& Operations Manager will be responsible for managing the company’s day\-to\-day admissions sales and operational activities.
 



 The selected candidate will work directly with the CEO and management and take ownership of the telecalling team, closing counsellors, CRM processes, lead management, recruitment support, training, performance monitoring and admission\-target achievement.
 



 This is a leadership position suitable for a candidate who can independently manage teams, establish processes and drive business growth.
 



  





 Key ResponsibilitiesSales and Admissions Management
 


* Manage the complete student\-admission process, from lead allocation to admission confirmation.
* Set daily, weekly and monthly targets for telecallers and closing counsellors.
* Monitor lead\-response time, follow\-ups, counselling quality and conversion rates.
* Support the team in handling difficult parent objections and high\-value admission closures.
* Ensure hot leads are transferred to closing counsellors without delay.
* Track admission documentation, fee payments and confirmation status.
* Develop and execute strategies to achieve monthly and annual admission targets.



 Team Management
 


* Manage telecallers, admission counsellors and other sales\-support employees.
* Conduct daily morning meetings and evening performance reviews.
* Monitor employee attendance, discipline, productivity and target achievement.
* Identify underperforming employees and implement coaching and improvement plans.
* Motivate the team and maintain a professional, target\-oriented work environment.
* Coordinate employee recruitment, onboarding, training and assessments.
* Support management in building and scaling the admissions team.



 CRM and Lead Management
 


* Manage lead allocation and follow\-up processes through LeadSquared or a similar CRM.
* Ensure every call, follow\-up and lead stage is updated accurately.
* Segregate leads based on course, location, interest level and admission readiness.
* Monitor missed follow\-ups, inactive leads and overdue tasks.
* Maintain accurate reports on leads, conversions, admissions and revenue.
* Ensure zero leakage of high\-potential leads.



 Operations Management
 


* Oversee day\-to\-day office and admissions operations.
* Coordinate with college admission teams and management representatives.
* Maintain updated information about colleges, courses, fees, hostels and admission procedures.
* Ensure the team has the required call scripts, comparison sheets and college information.
* Establish SOPs for admissions, follow\-ups, documentation and payment tracking.
* Coordinate with marketing, data, HR/admin and management teams.
* Handle student, parent and college\-related escalations professionally.
* Submit daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports to the CEO and management.



 Training and Quality Control
 


* Train telecallers and counsellors on courses, colleges, scripts, CRM and objection handling.
* Conduct mock calls, performance assessments and refresher training.
* Review call recordings and provide structured feedback.
* Improve call quality, counselling standards and team conversion ratios.
* Ensure consistent communication and service quality across the team.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Any Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in sales, admissions, counselling, business development or operations.
* Previous team\-handling experience is mandatory.
* Experience managing a team of 5–10 members is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of sales funnels, lead follow\-ups and admission closures.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM software, Excel or Google Sheets.
* Strong Tamil and English communication skills.
* Good leadership, negotiation, problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to work independently and take responsibility for business outcomes.
* Must be comfortable working in a target\-driven environment.
* Must be willing to work full\-time from our Coimbatore office.



 Preferred Industry Background
 



 First preference will be given to candidates with experience in:
 


* EdTech companies
* College admission consultancies
* Education counselling organisations
* Coaching or training institutes
* University or college admissions departments
* Overseas education consultancies
* Target\-driven inside\-sales organisations



 Key Skills
 


* Team leadership and people management
* Admissions sales and counselling
* Telecalling\-team management
* CRM and lead\-funnel management
* Target planning and performance monitoring
* Parent objection handling
* Admission closing and negotiation
* Recruitment and employee training
* MIS reporting and data analysis
* Process development and operations management
* College relationship management
* Strong ownership and accountability



 Performance Areas
 



 The selected candidate will be evaluated based on:
 


* Team productivity and discipline
* CRM accuracy and process compliance
* Lead follow\-up completion
* Call quality and counselling standards
* Lead\-to\-admission conversion
* Monthly and annual admission targets
* Employee training and retention
* Reporting accuracy and operational efficiency
* Overall business growth



 Candidate Preference
 


* Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period will be preferred.
* Candidates residing in Coimbatore or willing to relocate can apply.
* Applicants must have genuine team\-management experience and a strong performance record.



 How to Apply
 



 Interested candidates can send their updated resume along with:
 


* Current location
* Total work experience
* EdTech/education\-sector experience
* Maximum team size handled
* Current salary
* Expected salary
* Notice period



 📞 WhatsApp/Contact: 8438516677
 



 📧 Email: dreamlife.eduservices@gmail.com
 



 Dream Life Educational Services
 


* Your Career, Our Mission.

title: BANQUET MANAGER
description:
**Company Description** 
 Jenneys Residency is a landmark hotel in Coimbatore, known for offering warm, world\-class hospitality for over two decades. Conceived as the dream project of the late chairman, Mr. L. Adaikalaraj of the LA Group of companies, the hotel is built on the belief that every guest is treated like family. Ideally located just minutes from Coimbatore International Airport, it is a preferred choice for both business and leisure travelers. The property features well\-appointed rooms and suites, multi\-cuisine dining options, elegant banquet and conference venues, and dedicated 24\-hour service to create memorable stays for a wide variety of guests and events.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Banquet Manager role is a full\-time, on\-site position based at Jenneys Residency in Coimbatore. The Banquet Manager is responsible for planning, organizing, and supervising banquets and events, ensuring smooth operations from pre\-event coordination to post\-event follow\-up. Day\-to\-day tasks include managing banquet bookings, coordinating with clients to understand event requirements, preparing event layouts, and overseeing food and beverage service. The role involves leading and scheduling banquet staff, collaborating closely with the kitchen and front office teams, monitoring service quality, and resolving any operational or guest\-related issues promptly. The Banquet Manager is also expected to maintain high standards of guest satisfaction, adhere to safety and hygiene guidelines, and contribute to revenue growth through effective upselling and cost control.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong customer\-focused abilities, including Customer Satisfaction and Customer Service skills.
* Excellent Communication skills for interacting with guests, team members, and external partners.
* Sound knowledge of Food \& Beverage operations, banquet service standards, and menu coordination.
* Experience in Hiring, training, and supervising banquet and service staff.
* Prior experience as a Banquet Manager or in hotel events management, preferably in a full\-service or upscale property.
* Ability to manage multiple events, prioritize tasks, and work effectively under time pressure.
* Strong leadership, problem\-solving, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and quality.
* Diploma or degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality, or a related field is preferred.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on event schedules.
